build_method: Option B (hybrid HTML overlay), per carousel-tile-generation.md standing default. Backgrounds generated with scripts/kie_image_gen.mjs (kie.ai gpt-image-2-text-to-image; this machine has no working Python interpreter, per prior posts' notes) — feed at 3:4/2K, story at 9:16/2K: close-up of a man's hands holding a smartphone inside a modern barbershop, screen rendered as a soft blank warm-gold glow (no fake UI), duotone black-and-white with gold key-light, barber chair and bulb lighting softly blurred in the background. Text/logo layer is real HTML+CSS (index.html / index-story.html): a display-size gold eyebrow, one-word gold highlight in the Lost in South headline, a numbered 3-row benefit list in Fira Sans Condensed (all digits/labels — never the marker font, per its missing-glyph bug), and a bordered CTA bar. Deliberately kept to a single tile + story (no carousel) and a short 3-point list rather than the full paragraph the client provided, per explicit request that the art not read as text-heavy — the longer explanation lives only in instagram_caption below. CTA is 'link en la bio' per client's confirmed choice, not a literal URL in the art. Rendered to PNG via headless Chrome at --force-device-scale-factor=2 (1080x1350 -> 2160x2700 feed, 1080x1920 -> 2160x3840 story). Distinct from the earlier hyperframes video projects on the same topic (posts/instagram/sistema-citas-story/, posts/instagram/como-agendar-citas/, both July 2026) — this is a separate static announcement, not a replacement for those. Revision (same day): client reviewed v1 (small gold pill for 'Nuevo sistema de citas') and asked that it read 'en grande también, así como tu cita ahora en segundos' — replaced the pill with a Lost in South display eyebrow (54px, gold, two lines) plus a short gold-deep hairline underneath, matching the headline's scale and register while keeping SEGUNDOS as the only in-line highlight word so the two blocks don't compete. This also filled the dead-space upper half of the v1 feed tile. Revision 2 (2026-09-11): client asked to drop the speed promise 'Tu cita ahora en segundos' entirely and reframe the message around the fact that the system itself changed — new headline 'AGENDAR AHORA / ES MÁS FÁCIL' (highlight: 'MÁS FÁCIL'), and the 3-row benefit list rewritten to 01 Cambiamos de sistema / 02 Nueva versión / 03 Seguimos mejorando (dropped the old horarios-en-tiempo-real / confirmás-y-listo / recordatorio-automático claims, which the client didn't ask to keep). Eyebrow, CTA, and both background photos (assets/bg.png, assets/bg-story.png) are unchanged — text-only revision, no new image generation.
